notes.title: Second Chance: Global offensive
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's your dev team here, and we're thrilled to announce that the latest game update is ready! Honestly, we can hardly believe we pulled this off before the year ended!

To be completely honest, when we said we underestimated the size of Chapter 5, we had no idea just how much we underestimated it... Starting August 8, we've been fully focused on completing Lin's storyline for this chapter. It seemed like it wouldn’t be too hard, and we even managed to delight you with two updates featuring HCG scenes along the way. There was just a little left to do—or so we thought. Turns out, we were wrong.

A lot has happened since then. We reevaluated our approach to developing the game, added tons of new content, and reworked a lot of the mechanics under the game's hood. Heck, we even upgraded to a new version of our game engine for the first time in ages!

In today’s update, we focused on releasing the missing interaction scenes with Lin at the pool. That means two brand-new HCG scenes! But that’s not all! We’ve also translated the game into several new languages. Let’s go through it all step by step:

What’s New:
[list]
[*] An ungodly amount of new code, dialogue, and translations (seriously, it’s physically impossible to count—we’ve made over 60 GitHub commits just related to code and dialogue).
[*] Two new HCG scenes featuring Lin.
[*] A total of 30 new HCG images for the two scenes.
[*] Completely reworked character galleries. Oh man, my eye twitches just thinking about how much effort and trial-and-error this took. It was tough.
[*] Two new localization languages: German and Chinese. Yes, you heard that right—two new languages! The translations were done using automated tools since we don’t speak these languages ourselves, but hey, they’re here and they work! It’s kind of a miracle.
[*] Tons of fixes for English translation issues.
[*] New sprites for toys from Jenna’s shop.
[*] Removed two achievements (they were hard to obtain and buggy anyway, plus Steam doesn’t let us have more than 100 achievements... We might remove a few more in the future if they’re not relevant).
[*] Added two new achievements tied to the new content!
[*] Added technical support for future DLC.
[/list]

[b]Important Note:[/b]: [i] Using old save files may cause unexpected bugs. We strongly recommend starting a new game.[/i]

This update is another one of those that we’d love to call the biggest ever, as we’ve poured so much effort into it over the past few months. However, the previous major update still holds the crown. That said, this one takes a well-earned second place!

The New Year is just around the corner, and we’ll kick it off by hunting down and fixing bugs. Until then, we wish you all good health, great games, and fantastic vibes!

Thank you for sticking with us!
With love,
COMAN and ELIANA

notes.title: Christmas Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's your devs here!

The Christmas and New Year season has always been something special. The frost that chills you to the bone, the snow blanketing everything outside and keeping you indoors, and of course, the endless dark nights (a special bonus for those of us living in northern regions, like we do). But this year, most of those magical experiences (except the nights) decided to skip us entirely: it's +4°C outside, the snow forecast has turned into rain, and the holiday vibes are a bit harder to catch. So how do you get into the festive spirit? Well, how about enjoying your favorite game!

And to become one of those favorite games, we've prepared an update that’s coming very soon (hopefully before 2025)! And no, it’s not just a Santa hat for Roshan!

This update will have text, pictures, and… well, something else we can't quite remember!

Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year (just in case we don't make it in time)!

With love,
COMAN & ELIANA

notes.title: Rising from the Deep
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The developers here, and we're excited to announce that the latest game update is ready!

We've previously mentioned that the scope of the fifth chapter was too large for us to release all at once. Working on this latest update has only confirmed this. Today, we're finally presenting you with the continuation of Lin's story up to the end of the fifth chapter!

What's new:
[list]
[*] Over 20,000 lines of code, dialogues, and translations
[*] The possibility of starting chapter 5 differently
[*] New location - First Aid Room
[*] New location - Basement
[*] New location - Basement Room
[*] New location - Dormitory Entrance
[*] Lux - New exclusive costume
[*] Lisandra - New character! (FINALLY!)
[*] Howard - Got his own sprite!
[*] Ashley - Also got his own sprite!
[*] Two new characters we won't reveal here!
[*] One more way to die!
[*] 19 new musical compositions
[*] Music now available in all chapters!
[*] 1 new HCG scene
[*] 93 new drawings for the new HCG scene
[*] Second Lin HCG now available in galleries
[*] Lin's gallery slightly reworked (leave your feedback!)
[*] Sprites for new items
[*] 23 new achievements
[*] Fresh update of credits
[*] Full English translation of the game
[/list]

[b]Caution[/b]: [i]Using old saves may cause unexpected errors. We strongly recommend starting a new game.[/i]

With the last major patch, we began adding music to our game to enhance the atmosphere. Several compositions were specially written for the game by [b]Scraps[/b] and [b]Andrias Bartlett[/b], but since we aren't composers ourselves, filling the game with music took longer. With this update, we finally close this gap and can confidently say that now all content in the game has musical accompaniment, thanks to music under the Creative Commons license. Now the game's atmosphere will be conveyed more fully than before.

More than two years have passed since the last update. Two incredibly difficult years. Not just for us, but for the whole world. Just over two years ago, on January 27, 2022, when releasing the Angel's Flight update, we couldn't even imagine what fate had in store for us. Back then, we hoped to release this update by summer 2022, but its release was delayed for an insanely long two years. Today, releasing this update, just like two and a half years ago, we expect to be able to release the next update very soon (especially considering that most of the content for this update is already prepared).

In the near future, we'll be hunting for bugs in the current update, so don't forget to write your bug reports in the discussions - this greatly simplifies our work on errors and speeds up the release of new content!

Once again we would like to say thank you very much for staying with us!
With love,
COMAN and ELIANA

notes.title: Announcement of update 0.05.8.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The Second Chance developers are back in touch!
We're here, which means we have some amazing news!

Nothing terrible has happened to us since the last announcement (hooray!), so we're happy to tell you a bit more about the upcoming update. And believe us, it was worth the wait!

Ready? Hold on tight, because here's what's in store for you:

- Over 20,000 lines of new code! Yes, you heard that right. This includes new dialogues and a full translation into English. Our fingers are still smoking!
- A new HCG gallery with more than 90 images. Our sole artist has been working tirelessly (with graphics tablets in hand).
- Several new locations with their own atmospheric backgrounds. Get ready to explore!
- Four new characters with fresh sprites and a few old acquaintances who have finally emerged from the folders of our computers.
- And of course, a bunch of new achievements! Because who doesn't love achievements, right?

But that's not all! The fresh update will allow you to continue Lin's story right from where it left off earlier. And trust us, the mysteries surrounding her are thickening like never before. Will Lin be able to overcome this seemingly insurmountable force? It depends only on you and your actions!

Oh, and we almost forgot! We've hidden some interesting tidbits that will shed light on past events. Get ready to look at some things that previously seemed obvious in a new way...

And now for the most important part - the release date! Drum roll... The update will be out on Thursday, August 8, 2024!

We can't wait for you to dive into new adventures. Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Preview of update 0.05.8.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's the Second Chance game developers here!
What? You thought we abandoned the game? Pffft! Of course not!

Two years ago, when we released a small update, we had no idea how much our lives would change in the near future. Back then, we planned to release the next story update in just a couple of months - summer 2022. But, as you noticed, that didn’t happen.

Over these two years, a lot has changed, and many things have happened. We had to leave our home and start from scratch in a new country. These were very challenging times. Nevertheless, the game development never stopped. We kept writing text, fixing code, creating new art, and designing future updates. Unfortunately, the work wasn't as regular as we would have liked, so we couldn’t frequently share news about new content with you. However, we did share some updates about our progress on our Patreon and Boosty.

But enough time has passed, and now we're ready to announce that we’ve prepared the update that should have come out two years ago!

This time, the story of Lynn will continue. Along the way, we'll meet new characters who might have a big impact on our destiny. Additionally, some old characters will reappear in a slightly different light. But most importantly, we will influence Lynn's fate.

We'll tell you more about the upcoming update very soon!

A huge thanks to everyone who supports us on Patreon and Boosty. Thanks to you, we can still keep working on the project!

notes.title: Angel's Flight
notes.content:
Hello all, the developers are here, and we're happy to tell you that the fresh game update is ready!

As mentioned earlier, the size of chapter five was larger than we had planned, and on closer inspection, it was even larger than we had re-planned for. Today we're finally removing the familiar Seraz stub, giving you a full playthrough of this story all the way to the end of chapter five!

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*] About 7000 lines of code and dialogs
[*] New location - Hospital
[*] New location - The Road
[*] New location - Asylum Club
[*] New location - Karaoke room
[*] Amber - a new character you can meet in the city
[*] A new set of costumes and a new location to meet Karmala
[*] 20 new music tracks
[*] 2 new HCG scenes
[*] 94 new drawings for new HCG scenes
[*] Seraz is now available in the galleries
[*] New sprite for the fang
[*] Sprites for two new items
[*] 17 new achievements
[*] Fresh credits update
[*] Full English translation
[/list]

As you can see, we began to fill our game with music to emphasize the atmosphere at certain points. It turned out to be quite a complicated process, especially since we're not musicians ourselves and we're not connected with music and, apart from a few songs written specifically for the game by [b]Scraps[/b] and [b]Andrias Bartlett[/b], we used music with a creative commons license. So far, we've only filled in music that is relevant to fresh content. We plan to add music to the entire fifth chapter in the near future.

It's been a year since the last update, and it's been a hell of a year for us and for the rest of the world. We really hope that now that things have more or less stabilized, we'll be able to release updates more often. In addition to adding music to the entire fifth chapter, our immediate plans include releasing an update continuing the storyline for at least one more character within chapter five. In the very near future, however, we will focus on fixing possible bugs in the current version of the game.

Once again I want to say a big thank you for staying with us!
With love,
COMAN and ELIANA

notes.title: February cleaning!
notes.content:
It's been a while since the last update. Sometimes it seems as if the world has fallen into chaos... Wait a minute... It did, didn't it? 

Since the last update we've been working hard on the new content, but at this point we realize that the upcoming volume of chapter 5 is so large that even working on the individual story branches is too time-consuming. But we're trying to keep up the pace despite the challenges.

In this update we tried to solve the most pressing issues facing the technical component of the game. This will allow us to release future updates with greater ease in the future.

List of changes
[list]
[*] The credits have been updated. They now have January 2021 relevance.
[*] The technical component of the credits has been changed. This change should solve all the problems with getting the achievement for watching credits.
[*] New music has been added (special thanks to Jacob "Scraps" Gilbert for it!).
[*] Three hidden achievements were added.
[*] Something else is added that allows you to get these achievements.
[*] Fixed some bugs and typos in Russian and English versions of the game.
[*] English localization packages were updated
[/list]

For now, this is something of a starter pack of updates. We're working on introducing a larger update as soon as possible, which will significantly extend the storyline of one of the characters.

Today we have added another part to Chapter 5, so we have raised the version of the game to 0.05.2.2... For now, that part is only available when you go through Jace's storyline in Chapter Four.

[b]So, in today's update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the option to help Seraz in chapter five
[*] Added another mini-game with a fight.
[*] Added English translation for all new content
[*] Added 5 achievements related to new content.
[*] Reworked the game launch sequence.
[*] The content warning and age verification screens have been completely rewritten to prevent rare errors with the inability to start playing on some builds of [i]Unix[/i] systems.
[*] The credits have been updated as of [i]1 June 2020[/i]. If you supported the game on Patreon from January 2020 to June 2020, you can now find your name in the credits.
[*] Fixed typos in both Russian and English versions.

[/list]

It took us quite a while to create this relatively small update, so it is possible that some details may have been lost in time. That being the case, we can say that this is probably not a complete list of changes.

Now that the problems are slowly but surely receding, we hope to be able to release updates more often.

Thank you so much for staying with us!
With love,
COMAN & ELIANA

notes.title: March, 31 (Beta update)
notes.content:
So, ok. It's time to set beta release live.
To get access to beta release in Steam:
1. Right click on Second Chance in steam lib
2. Settings
3. Beta-release
4. Choose "testing_new_content" in list
5. Game will be updated. We can play it.
6. To revert changes, just make the same, but in 4th choose "Decline"

Game starts at chapter 5 - it's ok
When game ends, game will be closed - it's ok

Don't forget to report all bugs in game discussions.
It's not yet finished chapter. It's just public beta.
